artifacts.summary: Confirmed root causes and file:line evidence for all three coupled defects (focus-prompt threading, forced-phase fall-through, per-run cycle budget + artifact-based admission), named the exact existing tests that must be inverted, and flagged cross-cutting interactions for the planner.

memory_candidates.content: jq's `//`/`//=` operators cannot distinguish an absent map key from a key explicitly set to an empty array/null-falsy value that was previously populated then emptied (e.g. a queue popped down to []). When a bash+jq state machine needs to tell 'never started' apart from 'started and finished', use `has($k)` (or a separate boolean/marker map) instead of relying on `// default` alone.

In this repo's orchestrator engine, a test whose NAME states the intended contract but whose ASSERTIONS prove the opposite (e.g. 'stop-after-last-named' asserting fall-through) is a reliable signal that the contract was never actually implemented, only documented/named aspirationally. When auditing for a described defect, grep test names for the claimed contract and read the actual assertions, not just the name.
